DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The patient describes a sustained, constant sensation of spinning rather than the brief episodes typical of BPPV, and diphenhydramine only slightly alleviates symptoms. Given the unilateral nature of the complaint and the lack of positional triggers in your description, have you noticed any recent head trauma, or do you have any hearing loss, tinnitus, or ringing in your ears?
